basic_info.description: Elegant Marina-style full-floor condominium in the heart of San Francisco, blending timeless character with thoughtful modern upgrades. This spacious home offers three bedrooms and two bathrooms, designed for both comfort and style.    The formal living room features a fireplace, built-in cabinets, and abundant natural light, while the formal dining room provides a gracious setting for gatherings and entertaining. At the center of the home, a chef's kitchen is equipped with premium appliances: a Thermador stove with built-in charcoal grill and range hood, brand-new Bosch double ovens and dishwasher, a Miele refrigerator, and generous prep space.    Throughout the home, you'll find beautiful hardwood floors. Additional conveniences include a newer in-unit LG washer/dryer, custom made window shutters, a large shared storage room at the garage level, and a shared backyard retreat with a blooming plum tree. Parking is at a premium in the city, and this residence includes two parking spaces.    Located on a Haight/ Cole Valley border, this home is close to Golden Gate Park, world-class museums, the lively Haight, Divisadero Corridor entertainment, UCSF, schools, shopping, restaurants, and public transit.This is one of San Francisco's most connected and desirable neighborhoods.
